header: Ordered stages with a status and a percentage
lead: Each stage gets a status and a typed percentage. Editors set both, so give the date in the note.
note: Example: a museum website relaunch, as at 30 September 2026. A stage at 0 % has not started and one at 100 % is finished; the marker repeats what the percentage says.
